content: We need to state count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system may have a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") but we don't know its structure. We need to get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? Could retrieve carbon shifts to see aromatic region (~120-150 ppm). But we need count. Better to get 13C NMR and count peaks in aromatic region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
